callPurpose.en: The caller wants to hold something with limited capacity for a date or date range: a table, a room, a hall, a vehicle, equipment. They ask if it is free, what it costs for those dates, and what the deposit is.
callPurpose.ms: Pemanggil mahu menempah sesuatu yang kapasitinya terhad bagi satu tarikh atau julat tarikh: meja, bilik, dewan, kenderaan, peralatan. Mereka tanya ada kosong atau tidak, berapa kos bagi tarikh itu, dan berapa depositnya.

label.en: The units a customer reserves
Whether you rent by slot, hour, day or night, with check-in and check-out or pickup and return times
label.ms: Sama ada disewa mengikut slot, jam, hari atau malam, dengan waktu daftar masuk dan keluar atau ambil dan pulang

facts.example: Ikut malam. Daftar masuk 3 petang, daftar keluar 12 tengah hari.

label.en: Rates for weekday, weekend, public holiday and peak season
label.ms: Kadar hari biasa, hujung minggu, cuti umum dan musim puncak

label.en: What counts as peak: school holidays, festive weeks, long weekends
label.ms: Apa yang dikira musim puncak: cuti sekolah, minggu perayaan, hujung minggu panjang

facts.example: Cuti sekolah, minggu Hari Raya, Tahun Baru Cina dan malam cuti umum.

label.en: Minimum nights, hours or spend
Maximum people, extra-person charges, and what is not allowed
label.ms: Had bilangan orang, caj orang tambahan, dan apa yang tidak dibenarkan

facts.example: Maksimum 10 orang. Tiada majlis, tiada haiwan peliharaan, tidak boleh merokok di dalam rumah.

label.en: What the price includes

facts.example: Aircon semua bilik, WiFi, dapur lengkap, tuala, 2 parkir.

label.en: Every extra charge: cleaning, extra bed, late check-out, tourism tax, fuel, mileage, service charge
label.ms: Setiap caj tambahan: pembersihan, katil tambahan, lewat daftar keluar, cukai pelancongan, minyak, perbatuan, caj perkhidmatan

label.en: Booking deposit, security deposit, when the balance is due, and when the security deposit is returned
label.ms: Deposit tempahan, deposit keselamatan, bila baki perlu dijelaskan, dan bila deposit keselamatan dipulangkan

facts.example: Deposit tempahan 50%. Deposit keselamatan RM 100, dipulangkan dalam 3 hari selepas pemeriksaan.

label.en: Cancellation and date-change terms in full
label.ms: Terma pembatalan dan pertukaran tarikh sepenuhnya

facts.example: Batal 14 hari sebelum: deposit dipulangkan penuh. 7 hingga 13 hari: boleh tukar tarikh sekali. Kurang 7 hari: deposit tidak dipulangkan.

label.en: Documents or conditions: identity card, driving licence, age, marriage certificate, permit
label.ms: Dokumen atau syarat: kad pengenalan, lesen memandu, umur, sijil nikah, permit

facts.example: Salinan kad pengenalan penyewa. Sewa kereta: lesen memandu sah, umur 23 ke atas.

label.en: How keys, access or the vehicle are handed over and returned
label.ms: Cara kunci, akses atau kenderaan diserah dan dipulangkan

facts.example: Kod pintu dihantar melalui WhatsApp pada hari daftar masuk selepas baki dijelaskan.

label.en: For restaurants: largest table, how long a table is held, seating time limit, deposit for big groups
label.ms: Untuk restoran: meja terbesar, berapa lama meja dipegang, had masa makan, deposit kumpulan besar

facts.example: Meja dipegang 15 minit. Kumpulan lebih 10 orang perlu deposit RM 100.

label.en: Things offered alongside: catering, decoration, sound system, driver, airport pickup
label.ms: Perkhidmatan tambahan: katering, hiasan, sistem bunyi, pemandu, ambil di lapangan terbang

label.en: Licence or permit you hold and may state
label.ms: Lesen atau permit yang anda pegang dan boleh nyatakan

catalogue.reason: Needed when there are more than a few units or rate tiers: a fleet, several houses, packages for a hall. One row per unit or package.

interview.en: What exactly do customers reserve from you, and how many of each do you have?
interview.ms: Apa sebenarnya yang pelanggan tempah daripada anda, dan berapa banyak setiap satu?

interview.en: Do you rent by the hour, day, night or session? What are the check-in and check-out, or pickup and return, times?
interview.ms: Anda sewakan ikut jam, hari, malam atau sesi? Apakah waktu daftar masuk dan keluar, atau ambil dan pulang?

interview.en: What are your rates on a normal weekday and at the weekend?
interview.ms: Berapa kadar anda pada hari biasa dan hujung minggu?

interview.en: Which dates are peak for you, and what is the rate then?
interview.ms: Tarikh mana yang dikira musim puncak, dan berapa kadarnya?

interview.en: Is there a minimum stay, minimum hours or minimum spend?
interview.ms: Ada minimum malam, minimum jam atau perbelanjaan minimum?

interview.en: How many people does each unit take? What do you not allow?
interview.ms: Setiap unit muat berapa orang? Apa yang anda tidak benarkan?

interview.en: List every extra charge a customer could be asked to pay.
interview.ms: Senaraikan setiap caj tambahan yang mungkin diminta daripada pelanggan.

interview.en: How do you know which dates are free today: a book, a calendar app, a booking site, your memory?
interview.ms: Macam mana anda tahu tarikh mana yang kosong sekarang: buku, aplikasi kalendar, laman tempahan, ingatan?

interview.en: Do you also list on booking sites or apps? Who updates the calendar when a booking comes from there?
interview.ms: Anda juga senaraikan di laman atau aplikasi tempahan? Siapa kemas kini kalendar bila tempahan masuk dari sana?

interview.en: What deposit holds a date? Is there a separate security deposit, and when do you return it?
interview.ms: Deposit berapa untuk pegang tarikh? Ada deposit keselamatan berasingan, dan bila dipulangkan?

interview.en: If a customer cancels or wants to change dates, what are your exact terms?
interview.ms: Kalau pelanggan batal atau mahu tukar tarikh, apakah terma tepat anda?

interview.en: What must the customer show or meet: identity card, licence, age, permit?
interview.ms: Apa yang pelanggan perlu tunjuk atau penuhi: kad pengenalan, lesen, umur, permit?

interview.en: How does the customer get the keys, access code or vehicle, and how do they return it?
interview.ms: Macam mana pelanggan dapat kunci, kod akses atau kenderaan, dan macam mana memulangkannya?

interview.en: For restaurant tables: how big a group can you seat, how long do you hold a table, is there a time limit?
interview.ms: Untuk meja restoran: kumpulan sebesar mana boleh dimuatkan, berapa lama meja dipegang, ada had masa?

interview.en: Do you offer extras such as catering, decoration, a sound system or a driver?
interview.ms: Ada tawarkan tambahan seperti katering, hiasan, sistem bunyi atau pemandu?

interview.en: What goes wrong during a rental that needs you at once, such as a breakdown, a lockout or no water?
interview.ms: Apa masalah semasa sewaan yang perlukan anda serta-merta, seperti kenderaan rosak, terkunci di luar atau tiada air?

interview.en: Which licence or permit do you hold that we may state if asked?
interview.ms: Lesen atau permit apa yang anda pegang yang boleh kami nyatakan jika ditanya?

interview.en: May the assistant hold a date by itself, or should every booking wait for you?
interview.ms: Bolehkah pembantu pegang tarikh sendiri, atau setiap tempahan perlu tunggu anda?

text.en: Never say a date, table, room or vehicle is free unless an availability tool confirmed it in this conversation. Otherwise say staff will check and confirm.
text.ms: Jangan kata tarikh, meja, bilik atau kenderaan kosong melainkan sistem kekosongan mengesahkannya dalam perbualan ini. Jika tidak, maklumkan staf akan semak dan sahkan.

text.en: Work out whether the date is a weekday, weekend or peak date before quoting, and say which rate you used.
text.ms: Tentukan sama ada tarikh itu hari biasa, hujung minggu atau musim puncak sebelum sebut harga, dan nyatakan kadar mana yang digunakan.

text.en: With any price, state the deposit, the security deposit and every extra charge that applies, and whether tax or service charge is included.
text.ms: Bersama sebarang harga, nyatakan deposit, deposit keselamatan dan setiap caj tambahan yang berkenaan, serta sama ada cukai atau caj perkhidmatan termasuk.

text.en: For a reservation request, record the unit wanted, dates and times, number of adults and children, purpose if it is an event, and name and number.
text.ms: Bagi permintaan tempahan, catat unit yang dikehendaki, tarikh dan masa, bilangan dewasa dan kanak-kanak, tujuan jika ia majlis, serta nama dan nombor.

text.en: If the caller asks for a unit, size or date rule that is not recorded, say so and offer to ask staff. Do not adapt another unit's rate.
text.ms: Jika pemanggil tanya unit, saiz atau syarat tarikh yang tidak direkodkan, maklumkan dan tawarkan untuk tanya staf. Jangan guna kadar unit lain.

text.en: State the cancellation and deposit terms in full as the owner wrote them. Do not describe a deposit as non-refundable in every case unless that is what the owner wrote.
text.ms: Nyatakan terma pembatalan dan deposit sepenuhnya seperti yang ditulis pemilik. Jangan kata deposit tidak dipulangkan dalam semua keadaan melainkan itu yang ditulis pemilik.

text.en: Never give out door codes, key locations, a guest's name, or whether a named person is staying or renting.
text.ms: Jangan dedahkan kod pintu, lokasi kunci, nama tetamu, atau sama ada seseorang yang dinamakan sedang menginap atau menyewa.

text.en: A customer who is locked out, broken down, in an accident or without water or power during a rental is handed off at once, at any hour. For an accident or injury, tell them to call 999 first.
text.ms: Pelanggan yang terkunci di luar, kenderaan rosak, terlibat kemalangan atau tiada air atau elektrik semasa sewaan diserahkan serta-merta, pada bila-bila masa. Bagi kemalangan atau kecederaan, minta mereka hubungi 999 dahulu.

text.en: Requests for a discount, long-stay rate, package deal or waiver of the deposit go to the owner.
text.ms: Permintaan diskaun, kadar sewaan panjang, pakej atau pengecualian deposit diserahkan kepada pemilik.

text.en: State only the licence, permit or insurance the owner recorded. Never describe cover or protection in your own words.
text.ms: Nyatakan hanya lesen, permit atau insurans yang direkodkan pemilik. Jangan terangkan perlindungan dengan perkataan sendiri.

text.en: When the caller's plan breaks a recorded limit, such as too many people or an event in a house that bans them, say so before taking details.
text.ms: Jika rancangan pemanggil melanggar had yang direkodkan, seperti terlalu ramai orang atau majlis di rumah yang melarangnya, maklumkan sebelum mengambil butiran.

text.en: After hours, quote rates and terms, take the request as a message, and hand off only for problems during a rental.
text.ms: Selepas waktu operasi, sebut kadar dan terma, ambil permintaan sebagai pesanan, dan serahkan hanya bagi masalah semasa sewaan.

gaps.name: check_range_availability
gaps.purpose: Availability across a date range, per unit or pooled, and for party size. check_availability covers one resource for at most 7 days and returns time slots, not nights or days.
gaps.untilBuilt: check_availability on single-slot resources such as one table; otherwise a message.

gaps.name: reserve_range
gaps.purpose: Hold a unit for a date range with party size, pending deposit. book_slot books one start instant.

gaps.name: quote_for_dates
gaps.purpose: Compute the total for given dates from weekday, weekend and peak rates plus extras, so the model does not do arithmetic.
gaps.dataNeeded: rate tiers and a peak-date calendar
gaps.untilBuilt: Agent quotes per-night rates and says staff will send the total.

gaps.name: external calendar sync
gaps.purpose: Read bookings that arrive from booking sites so the same date is not sold twice.

gaps.name: deposit_link
gaps.purpose: Send a payment link for the booking deposit.

knowledge.name: Homestay rates / kadar homestay / 民宿价格
knowledge.content: Homestay Contoh A costs RM 250 a night on weekdays and RM 320 a night at weekends. It sleeps up to 10 people. Homestay Contoh A RM 250 semalam hari biasa dan RM 320 semalam hujung minggu. Muat sehingga 10 orang. Homestay Contoh A平日每晚250令吉，周末每晚320令吉，最多可住10人。

knowledge.name: Check-in / daftar masuk / 入住时间
knowledge.content: Check-in is at 15:00 and check-out is at 12:00. Daftar masuk 15:00 dan daftar keluar 12:00. 入住时间15:00，退房时间12:00。

knowledge.name: Deposit / deposit / 订金
knowledge.content: A 50% booking deposit holds the date. A RM 100 security deposit is returned within 3 days after inspection. Deposit tempahan 50% untuk pegang tarikh. Deposit keselamatan RM 100 dipulangkan dalam 3 hari selepas pemeriksaan. 付50%订金保留日期，另收100令吉保证金，检查后3天内退还。

knowledge.name: House rules / peraturan rumah / 入住规则
knowledge.content: No parties or events, no pets, no smoking indoors. Tiada majlis, tiada haiwan peliharaan, tidak boleh merokok di dalam rumah. 不可举办派对或活动，不可带宠物，室内禁烟。

knowledge.name: Cancellation / pembatalan / 取消
knowledge.content: Cancel 14 days or more before check-in for a full refund of the booking deposit. Batal 14 hari atau lebih sebelum daftar masuk untuk pulangan penuh deposit tempahan. 入住前14天或以上取消可全额退还订金。
